item.title: 2nd FBEC — Friends in Brazilian Extremal Combinatorics
item.description:
Dates: January 18–29, 2027
Location: IMPA, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Description

The 2nd Friends in Brazilian Extremal Combinatorics (FBEC) will bring together faculty working in Extremal Combinatorics and graduate students for two weeks of collaborative work on open problems in Extremal Combinatorics. The event will also include discussions of the community’s future events, books and research projects.

Most of the programme will be devoted to work in small groups, formed around the problems and interests presented at the start of the meeting. Brief talks, where useful to the discussions, and progress reports will allow participants to exchange ideas and adjust the direction of their work over the two weeks.

item.title: 1st FBEC — Friends in Brazilian Extremal Combinatorics
item.description:
Dates: February 2–14, 2026
Location: IMPA, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Description

The 1st Friends in Brazilian Extremal Combinatorics (FBEC) took place at IMPA during the summer of 2026. The main focus of the event was twofold: to bring together Brazilian researchers to work on important open problems in Extremal Combinatorics; and to discuss and organise future events in Brazil, books in the area and research projects.

For the research part, the first day was dedicated to the presentation of problems and formation of groups. The following days were devoted to group work on the chosen problems, with progress reports on Friday mornings.

item.title: Extremal Combinatorics Outreach Tour
item.description:
The Extremal Combinatorics Outreach Tour is a travelling initiative to promote the field in Brazilian regions without established research groups, planned to begin in 2027.

The Project

The tour aims to visit 3 states per year without researchers working in extremal combinatorics. On each visit, our team delivers a four- to five-day introductory mini-course focusing on the foundations and central problems of the field.
